programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano llega a Bogotá y se aloja en un hotel de lujo, mientras la policía visita a su familia y comienza la investigación. Estando en Bogotá, es asaltado y golpead. Aturdido y deambulando por las calles, Emiliano encuentra el bar plaza Garibaldi.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Con ayuda de Rosario, Emiliano logra llamar a Felipe en México quien lo pone al tanto de la gravedad de su situación. Emiliano tendrá que hacer muchos cambios en su vida, deberá empezar por cambiarse el nombre y olvidar que es millonario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario presenta a Emiliano en casa y lo ayudan a curarle sus heridas. Por otro lado, Emiliano descubre que apresaron a Felipe y por esta razón no llegara el dinero que prometió enviarle. Todo se complica y es así como tendrá que huir.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El capitán Bernal informa al comandante Salas del operativo realizado en el hotel nacional. Por otro lado, Emiliano se encuentra desolado y sin dinero, deberá recurrir a Rosario a pesar de que no quiere involucrarla en sus problemas.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario lleva a Emiliano a una pensión donde pueda hospedarse los días que estará en Colombia. Por otro lado, en México realizan el allanamiento del lujoso apartamento de Emiliano, mientras tanto este duerme en un lugar sucio y frio.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Lucia le reclama a Diomedes porque está recibiendo llamadas de consuelo en Bogotá. Diomedes le dice que es la que dirige su club de fans, pero que no tiene nada con ella. Diomedes sigue reacio a volver a cantar por la muerte de Juancho.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Rosa tiene una discusión con Icho porque ella le reclama por una supuesta amante de él, quien termina siendo su hermana. Icho dolido decide romper con el compromiso de su matrimonio.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Consuelo se entera que Diomedes estuvo con Claudia, ella sufre mucho y Diomedes termina por pedirle perdón. Diomedes se toma las fotografías del nuevo álbum con Iván Zuleta. Gloria regaña a Claudia por llegar tarde.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes queda flechado con Betsy y cuando ambas mujeres suben a la tarima, Diomedes saca a bailar a Betsy, sin embargo, le agarra la cola y ella ofendida lo cachetea.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes logra deshacerse de los amigos de Betsy y se queda con ella, pero cuando intenta propasarse con Betsy ella lo saca de su casa. A Ramiro se le enferma su hija, Diomedes ayuda a su chofer en todo y se hace cargo de los gastos hospitalarios.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Lucia decide separarse de Diomedes y le cuenta todo a su hijo Israel quien la apoya. Diomedes espera a que Lucía lo perdone. Lucia busca un abogado y le dice a Diomedes que ella se tiene que quedar con la mitad de todo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano continúa recibiendo un gran apoyo de parte de Rosario y por su situación económica, le pide ayuda para conseguir un trabajo. Por otro lado, el capitán Bernal confirma una compra de electrodomésticos con las tarjetas de crédito de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario habla con Carlos Malagón para que le de trabajo a Emiliano en el Bar Plaza Garibaldi. Don Carlos se reúsa a contratar a Emiliano como mesero, es por esto que Rosario tendrá que convencerlo para que le haga una prueba como cantante.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Carlos está feliz y alardea con sus amigos de la contratación de un cantante mexicano en su bar, no obstante le prohíbe a su hija acercarse a Emiliano. Felipe informa al comandante Salas que Emiliano huyó por los consejos del licenciado Corona.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Christopher is barely 21, already has history of domestic abuse and assault, and now he's facing major time in a room without a view. This hunt won't be easy for Dog.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog is a big-hearted guy and today he's proving it. He's helping Mary Ellen, his friend and fellow bondsman, on a dangerous night hunt for a fugitive she is now regretting bailing out.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Today Dog finds himself looking for more than one fugitive. He starts the day looking for a woman who has skipped out on her court date.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: With Duane Lee back on the team, the rift in the Chapman clan appears over. But will time heal this wound or make it worse?

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Justin is the low man on the totem pole in the Chapman clan, and this means that the rest of the team is always teasing him.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog goes after Virginia, a hard-to-find lawbreaker. He gets a tip that a pickup truck will be going to Virginia's house. In true private-eye fashion.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Kolani's on the run, left his wife to look after four kids and left Dog holding the bag for the $10k bond. Apparently the lure of the streets and other women have drawn him away from his commitments.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog and his team are out to revoke bail on Eugene, a chronic heroin addict. They find him in a squalid apartment with a huge stockpile of syringes, and they can see that his physical condition is deteriorating.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: There is a running joke in the posse that every time Bobby Brown asks them for help with a fugitive he always promises them that it's "an easy one," but the hunts end up being epic searches.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog is trying to cut down on smoking, but it's not easy with his high-stress job. Today, he must track down Walter, a fugitive who believes that the Canadian military has planted a chip in his tooth.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: When the co-signer of a bond is also romantically involved with the defendant, sometimes the bondman is put in the middle of a lover's quarrel. But sometimes the defendant is a threat to the community and the cosigner asks the bondsman for protection.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Both brother Tim and fellow Honolulu bondsman James need Dog's help to track down their hard to find fugitives. The two cases on the docket today are challenging, especially the hunt for Gregory, a felon with a lengthy rap sheet.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog shows his love of justice and children in this poignant episode. He begins by giving encouragement to a group of handicapped children and making them honorary members of his posse.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: In Hawaii, Dog sets off from Honolulu to Kona to help his son Leland with some of his fugitives. First, a stop at Leland's boxing gym to warm up for their day of hunting with a quick sparring session and some father-and-son time together.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: A fugitive with a long criminal record has fled to Hawaii, and the bondsman on the mainland has asked Dog and the Posse for help. Dog doesn't have much information to work with, but he can use the felon's desire to impress his friends to track him down.

programme.desc: A one-hour special that looks back at 2006, one of Dog's most tumultuous years, which has included the passing of Beth's father, Dog and Beth's wedding, the tragic death of Dog's daughter Barbara, and the sudden arrest of Dog, Tim, and Leland.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Today the team isn't pulling any punches, literally or figuratively! In between tracking down a potentially dangerous ex-con facing a five year stretch in the big house, Leland is struggling to find time to train.

Secret and controversial plans to modernise the dairy are revealed while rumours about private lives of the parents cause a row at the prestigious local prep school. As other people linked to the dairy meet agonising deaths, long-held secrets start to emerge...

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When DCI Barnaby and DS Troy arrive in the sleepy village of Badger's Drift to investigate the sudden death of elderly Miss Emily Simpson, her next door neighbour insists that she had been murdered, after she had seen her return from a walk in the woods, unnerved and shocked by something she had witnessed. When the post mortem confirms her death was no accident, the pair discover that nothing is what it seems to be within the little village as they try to find out what exactly she saw. Their investigation introduces Barnaby and Troy to many eccentric and quirky residents and soon turns up a web of sex, blackmail and lies, and the possibility that the murder could be connected to a shooting accident two years ago, which claimed another woman's life.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: After debating on who their next guest speaker should be, the Midsomer Worthy Writers' Circle decide to invite famous writer, Max Jennings, to their next meeting, despite opposition to the choice by Gerald Hadleigh, the group's chairman. When Hadleigh is found dead the day after Jennings visit, brutally bludgeoned and stripped naked, Barnaby and Troy discover that the victim had many mysteries to him, prompting them to delve into his private life and his past. Matters soon become complicated when Jennings disappears and is later found dead, and a witness recalls seeing a mysterious woman in Hadleigh's house the night before his murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst investigating the murder of Agnes Gray, a quiet animal-loving woman who was bludgeoned to death and found floating in a river near to the village of Ferne Basset, Barnaby gets more than he bargained for when he attends his wife's performance in the Causton Amateur Dramatics' production of Amadeus. When Agnes's cousin, Esslyn Carmichael, inadvertently cuts his own throat during the final act, it's quickly discovered that the tape on the prop blade he had used was removed without anyone knowing. The detective is left wondering who had wanted to turn Esslyn's final act into a true coup de theatre, as he and Troy try to determine what the motive was behind the two murders.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Local villagers in Morton Fendle are up in arms, demanding answers from Alan Hollingsworth, the owner of a local craft centre they had invested in, after news comes out that it has recently fallen into financial turmoil. As tensions begin rising in the village, Barnaby soon suspects that something has happened to Alan's wife, Simone, when his behaviour suddenly changes. His suspicions are soon confirmed when it transpires that Simone was kidnapped, after one of Alan's neighbours is murdered, shortly after witnessing something they shouldn't have.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Bill Carter, one of the founders of a local New Age commune called the Lodge of the Golden Windhorse, dies suddenly after falling down some stairs and breaking his neck. Although there was uncertainty as to whether it was the result of an accident or murder, Barnaby and Troy find themselves having to determine which it was, when Ian Craigie, the commune's leader, is stabbed to death with a carving knife a few days later, while attending a spiritual seance with the rest of the commune and the parents of one of its members. It's not long before they discover hidden truths about the commune's founding and some of its members.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: After a local photographer wins an urban myth competition with his creation of The Wolf Hunter, it unexpectedly gains a cult following. However, when a man is killed, Barnaby and Winter must investigate if this myth has become murderous reality.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A local outcast, who was controversially acquitted of murder years earlier, is the latest inductee into a post-operative heart rehab club. Following his arrival, members' dreams of a second chance at life begin to be cut short.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: As the owners of Karras Games gather for a murder mystery weekend, the immersive experience takes a puzzling twist when a killer strikes for real. The police's detective skills are put to the test as they are forced to solve this case on their own.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The annual Midsomer Scarecrow Festival takes a grisly turn as bodies begin appearing on poles displayed alongside their straw creations; the investigation reveals rivalries that run deep and shows people will do just about anything to win.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Mummers, an amateur operatic society, rehearses for its charity concert when the body of an unknown man is found in the theatre; the investigation quickly becomes a race to discover who is desperate to take centre stage.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Each year, the village of Angel's Rise hosts the Psychic Fayre. Founded by the Saint-Stephens family in memory of their late daughter, the event attracts mediums, psychics and followers of the occult. When a body is found surrounded by ritual symbols on the eve of the festival, Barnaby must step into the spiritual world to find the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Milton Cross, a feudal estate with a church, farms, houses and acres of land, depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton for their livelihoods. But when Sonia Woodley is stabbed in the churchyard two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, Barnaby and Jones investigate, trying to work out who killed her. It soon becomes clear someone took a pair of tailor scissors to do the deed, but who amongst the villagers could have done so, is unclear, and the investigation is complicated, when the pair learn the local Anglican priest, the parish vicar, had received a letter from Sonia. When he himself is killed, the pair believe something in the letter may be key to solving the mystery.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby is not convinced about Mayor David Hicks' plans to revive an annual trip to Brighton, suspecting his proposal to buy coastal land there, is rather a fraudulent scheme. Naturally, he joins the trip, but during their time in Brighton, a hated property developer (Tim McInnerny) is beheaded on a ghost house ride, prompting Barnaby to team up with his cousin to determine whether the developer's renters, the mayor, a gloomy reverend (Mark Gatiss), or the lady of a large estate are responsible, and soon discovers a hotbed of jealously, debt, lies and more, conceal a far darker secret.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Ford Florey is a town with a Wild West Society and many grudges. During a Wild West show at the local faire, the witch on the 'Dunk the Witch' stall is well and truly dunked but laughter soon turns to horror when she doesn't get up and the water in the tank starts to turn red. Barnaby and Jones need to be quick on the draw to track down the murderer, and soon begin to wonder whether a dispute over land was the motive, or something far more sinister, especially when more people are killed, with methods linked to the Wild West.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life

The food culture in Kyushu dates back to the emperors of Japan, and the Black Current off the eastern shore has shaped the island's cuisine for centuries. programme.title: The Journey Within

Watch as he teams up with local houndsman Robin and a specialized pack of dogs to flush these rabbit-sized trophies from thick coastal vegetation. programme.title: The Journey Within

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, Mark Peterson finds himself deep in the heart of Peru and focuses on completing the prestigious South America Upland Slam. With only one bird remaining, the Western Peruvian Dove, the trip has led him to a private hunting property. This final challenge will take place over a cut cornfield, a favorite spot for the doves. To blend in, Mark and his team craft a makeshift blind using a mix of corn stalks, and timber, just enough cover while allowing for a clear shot. These West Peruvian Doves are known for their erratic flight patterns, often bouncing from one tree to another in a random manner, making timing and placement critical.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way

That’s when Jeff Danker reached out after seeing a social post and sent us a pin to one of his Ohio leases. We scouted it that evening, found birds, and on a rainy morning the next day, everything finally came together. Sometimes all it takes is one more push.

programme.title: Tommy Ryman
programme.desc: Tommy Ryman grew up with a new-age, folk singing mother and a traditional, Lutheran insurance-agent father. This XY equation evidently equals: acclaimed comedian. Ryman has earned the title of Semifinalist on NBC's Last Comic Standing. Roseanne Barr, a professed fan, raves she has “never seen anything like Tommy before in her whole life, he is one-of-a-kind, fantastic!” Ryman also recently won the title of Best of the Midwest at the prestigious Gilda's Laugh Fest. Ryman's act can be described as absurdist and clever, masked behind a very likable and innocent demeanor, often thought of as awkwardly charming. He is a favorite among audiences at top clubs, corporates, and colleges around the nation.

programme.title: Marc Yaffee
programme.desc: Adopted at birth and confused ever since, Marc takes his audiences on a comedy joyride as he explores his multi-ethnic roots and the culture clashes that fill his world. Marc's smart but relatable comedy demonstrates a universal appeal that has landed him appearances on PBS, Comics Unleashed, The Latino Laugh Festival and the Showtime special, Goin' Native. Funny not filthy, Marc serves audiences his original comedy recipe, specially prepared for non- stop laughs. Tasty topics, spicy premises and savory punchlines, are all dished out with a dash of sarcasm and a grain of salt. A regular in Las Vegas, Marc has performed six times overseas for Armed Forces Entertainment and he's a past winner of Ventura Comedy Festival's Funniest Person Contest.

programme.title: David Dyer
programme.desc: David Dyer has been performing at stand-up at comedy clubs and corporate events for over twenty years. He's worked with some of the best comics in the industry including Mike Birbiglia, Jim Breuer, and Lewis Black. He's been a contributing writer to NBC's Late Night with Jimmy Fallon and ABC's Politically Incorrect. He's a regular on the nationally syndicated Bob and Tom Show and often appears on the roster for their “Friends of The Bob and Tom Show” comedy tour. He's the host of a new web series called Sidecar Sessions where he interviews guests who are sitting in the sidecar of his motorcycle as David pilots the bike around town. David also created and stars in another web series called Pillars with co-star, Kevin Yon. David became an on-call firefighter with Grand Rapids Township in Michigan….his wife is nervous.

programme.title: Karen Rontowski
programme.desc: Karen Rontowski's fast-paced, quirky and charmingly optimistic comedy has been featured in clubs, TV, radio, and at corporate events all around the world. Her stand- up showcases endearing, self-effacing and intelligent characters that catch you by surprise every time. Karen uniquely blends comedy with her experience as a Paranormal Investigator and Reiki master. From fun with her family to her travels all over this great country Karen has fun where ever she goes. Her lighthearted confusion entertains kids of all ages. She is fascinated with the “afterlife” is convinced she will someday have a near death experience because, “I never finish anything.” She explains, “Sometimes a ghost will just do the same thing over and over in life. That's why I want to move into a house that is haunted by a maid." Karen's comedy is now featured in the new line of greeting cards called “Frank and Funny” sold at Target stores everywhere and is the comedy writer for “Haunted Magazine.” She is a regular on the Bob and Tom Radio Show and is a featured performer on their CD. Karen has appeared on The Late Show with David Letterman, Sirius Satellite Radio, Comics Unleashed, Comedy.com, Live at Gotham and Comedy Central. She has opened for show biz legends including Bob Hope, Ray Charles, David Brenner and the Monkees.

programme.title: Jason Love

Weekly: "Jason Love is comedy that brings people together."From the Hollywood Improv to Carolines on Broadway, Jasons audience continues to grow. He has performed overseas for the troops and on the seas for cruise lines. Jason was a finalist at the Cabo Comedy Festival and at the World Series of Comedy in Vegas.Jasons non-profit, Love & Laughter, brings free shows to cancer support communities and others in need. His podcast is produced by Levity Entertainment. He is represented by Don Casino Productions.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.18

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.19
programme.desc: Appointed as interim chairperson, Jaein struggles to address the hospital's most urgent issues, only to face resistance and noncooperation from multiple departments. Song Ah runs into Jung Kyung and hears about the recording and how much it means to Joon Young. In the end, she decides to break up with Joon Young.

programme.title: Do You Like Brahms? Ep.15

At the funeral, when Song Ah tells Joon Young about her recital and her plans as a violinist, Joon Young asks her if he can be her accompanist.

programme.title: Do You Like Brahms? Ep.16

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that's where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it's not just fishing — it's full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it's one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Local Knowledge

programme.title: Lo Negro del Negro
programme.desc: Un hombre empleado del gobierno aprovecha su posición para su beneficio apoderándose de una inmensa fortuna.

programme.title: Desvestidas y alborotadas
programme.desc: Una bella mujer es abandonada por su marido en su luna de miel, y los hombres en el hotel andan detrás de ella.

programme.title: S.O.S. Conspiración Bikini
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de mujeres hermosas, una organización internacional de terroristas crean problemas en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: El oreja rajada
programme.desc: Dos niños angustiados y un campesino hacen todo lo posible por salvar a un purasangre. El ranchero Andrés quiere deshacerse de él, pero al final reconoce los méritos del caballo.

programme.title: Kapax del Amazonas
programme.desc: Una antropóloga norteamericana viaja en un avión con su esposo, periodista y aviador. Se accidentan y caen en la mitad de la selva, él es devorado por las alimañas mientras Linda es rescatada por un aborigen.

programme.title: Caballos de acero
programme.desc: Un joven rico es aficionado al motociclismo y conoce a un teniente de la policía con quien rivaliza en aptitudes.

programme.title: El cachas de oro
programme.desc: Un conocido juez persigue a unos violadores y asesinos, hijos de Ramsés, y los mete a la cárcel, pero su padre los libera, por lo que el valiente juez se ve obligado a matarlos. Ramsés se vengará del juez matando a su prometida.

programme.title: Acapulqueña
programme.desc: Un millonario decide montar un espectáculo con una mujer de Acapulco y dos hombres se enamoran de ella.

programme.title: El oficio más antiguo del mundo
programme.desc: Un hombre perseguido es ayudado por unas prostitutas que le acogen y ocultan en la casa donde ellas trabajan.

programme.title: Los fugitivos
programme.desc: Cuatro jóvenes narcotraficantes huyen de la policía y se esconden en un rancho donde hay tres mujeres.

programme.title: Amargo destino
programme.desc: Un hombre es encarcelado por un crimen ocurrido accidentalmente y, al salir libre, la mala suerte lo persigue.

programme.title: Cacería implacable
programme.desc: Un hombre con mucha angustia trata de escapar de la tentación de la mafia representada por la perversión y las drogas.

programme.title: Transplante a la mexicana
programme.desc: Un mujeriego va a prisión por enamorar a una menor de edad, al tiempo una doctora quiere experimentar con sus órganos.

programme.title: La Lucha con la Pantera
programme.desc: Tres muchachas confundidas con el sexo y el amor cometen errores llevados por el deseo carnal.

programme.title: Ráfaga de Plomo
programme.desc: Una banda acribilla a los asistentes de un bar y dos hermanos se disponen a encontrar a los criminales.

programme.title: La mafia amarilla
programme.desc: Una pandilla china asesina a un hombre y Blue Demon, con la ayuda de su amigo, tiene que encontrar al culpable.

programme.title: Vámonos para la feria
programme.desc: Un hombre decide que es hora de que sus dos hijos se casen. Para eso, acude a su compadre, que tiene dos bellas hijas.

programme.title: Noche de muerte
programme.desc: Un delincuente se disfraza como un famoso luchador y asalta varios lugares matando a los guardias de seguridad.

programme.title: Dos valientes
programme.desc: Martín, un pistolero, es asesinado, pero antes de morir pide que le oculten su identidad a su hijo. Este corre peligro cuando asiste a su funeral.

programme.title: Santo: Infraterrestre
programme.desc: Las fuerzas del bien se enfrentan a las malévolas intenciones de los Infraterrestres, seres de otro planeta que intentarán apoderarse de la Tierra.

programme.title: El corrido de María Pistolas
programme.desc: Un hombre finge estar del lado de los ricos para enterarse de sus planes, y así los revolucionarios venzan en un ataque.

programme.title: Con la Muerte en Ancas
programme.desc: Dos pistoleros, con personalidades distintas, uno, un hombre justo, y el otro, un asesino psicópata, buscan la venganza.

programme.title: Cuna de valientes
programme.desc: En colegio militar, cuatro jóvenes se hacen amigos y juntos comparten mucho, pero solamente dos de ellos se gradúan.

programme.title: Hay ángeles con espuelas
programme.desc: Un hombre mujeriego, que todos pensaban muerto, regresa para visitar a su abuela con una gran sorpresa.

programme.title: Mis hijos
programme.desc: Veinte años de haber sufrido un accidente, una mujer recupera la memoria e intenta desesperadamente encontrar a sus tres hijos.

programme.title: Los malvados
programme.desc: Un anciano es defendido por tres bandidos de unos asaltantes, y cuando muere, les pide que cuiden de su joven nieta.

programme.title: Tlayucán
programme.desc: Por una situación límite, un hombre se convierte en ladrón. Si su identidad se conoce, sus vecinos podrían lincharlo. La única persona amable de la ciudad es el sacerdote local.

programme.title: Asesinos de la noche
programme.desc: Un hombre manda a matar a un enemigo, pero su orden no es acatada. Lleno de furia, asesina al matón y persigue por su cuenta a su rival.

programme.title: Cena de matrimonios
programme.desc: Cinco hombres ricos reciben llamadas afirmando que sus esposas los engañan, pero creen que es una broma.

programme.title: Bamba
programme.desc: Un hombre se entusiasma con una humilde mujer que remienda redes para pescar, pero el problema es que él está casado con una mujer rica.

programme.title: Los hijos de Don Venancio
programme.desc: Un comerciante queda viudo con cinco hijos a su cargo, quienes le dan severos problemas con su comportamiento.

programme.title: La Mafia del Crimen
programme.desc: Un apostador obliga a un médico a curar a un cómplice herido, pero este muere y la amante del muerto se enamora del galeno.

programme.title: Ventarrón
programme.desc: Un gánster explota a dos mujeres enamoradas de él, pero, a su vez, él se enamora de una joven y le promete cambiar de vida.

programme.title: El Calvario de una Madre
programme.desc: Una mujer exige justicia luego de enterarse de que su hijo homosexual, un marino, fue asesinado por sus compañeros.

programme.title: Los Nietos de Don Venancio
programme.desc: Un hombre vuelve a España para un festejo familiar y se entera de que ha ocurrido un incendio en su tienda.

programme.title: Semáforo en Rojo
programme.desc: Un grupo de ladrones profesionales organizan el robo de una valiosa joya.

programme.title: El Abandonado
programme.desc: Por considerarlo poca cosa, un hacendado impide la relación de su hija con un honrado labrador que trabaja para él.

programme.title: El médico de las locas
programme.desc: Un médico se hace cómplice de un hombre que trama falsificar el testamento de una de sus pacientes, una loca.

programme.title: Primero soy mexicano
programme.desc: Un hacendado espera a su hijo que fue a estudiar medicina a Estados Unidos sufre cuando él se avergüenza de su pueblo.

programme.title: División narcóticos
programme.desc: Unos traficantes obligan a los campesinos de la frontera a sembrar amapola y amenazan de muerte a quién se niegue.

programme.title: Esta noche no

programme.title: Esposa te doy

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty starts his plans for his revamped courtyard garden when he plants bare root trees. Also, Nick Bailey explores the strange world of lichens and finds out how these plants grow and thrive on trees, wood and stone.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team is in Liphook with a challenge on their hands. Anne and Shaun have a big garden, and a daughter who has her own ideas on what makes a perfect outdoor space. Can the Rich brothers save the day, or will Charlie's design suit the family best?

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Tracey and Rob's Newport home has it all: dangerous sloped banks, a multi-level space full of wild weeds, overgrown hedges and too many trees. For those brave enough to make it to the top, however, the garden offers a magnificent view.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie and the brothers go head to head to win the right to make over the garden of Christine and Tony, who were shot in a terrorist attack in Tunisia in June 2015. If ever a couple needed the peace and consoling virtues of a garden, it is this one.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie and the Rich brothers are in Northampton at the garden of Theresa and Martyn. The couple have retired and with their children moved out and providing them with grand children, they would like to enjoy a formal cottage garden.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty continues his travels to learn about the art of Japanese stonemasonry and the famous tea ceremonies and their accompanying gardens, before finally taking a lesson in the delicate art of traditional flower arranging.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond celebrate the horticultural genius of William Robinson in the gardens of his former home, Gravetye Manor in Sussex. Sue Kent gives her own garden some TLC.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty harvests his spuds and sows seeds for autumn veg. He also shows how to get plants for free by taking cuttings.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty shows how to harvest and store potatoes. He also adds late summer colour to the cottage garden and prunes shrub roses. Carol Klein travels to Norfolk to meet Adrian Bloom, a member of a horticultural dynasty.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty begins a new project when he starts a new soft fruit garden. He also plants new potatoes and divides herbaceous plants in the jewel garden. Also, Frances visits an extraordinary garden in Barbados which was developed from a collapsed cave.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives his advice on the best apples and pears to grow in small spaces when he begins to plant up his new fruit garden and gets on with planning for colour when he plants summer flowering bulbs.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Nick Bailey gets to grips with an unpromising patch of grass, and gives his tips on how to achieve a luscious lawn. We return to Adam Frost's garden as he starts to transform a herbaceous border and gives his advice on how to get rid of bindweed.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gets going on planting herbs in his new herb garden and gives advice on how to divide and move ornamental grasses. Plus, meet the queen of herbs, Jekka McVicar, as she builds a herb garden at the Malvern Show.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: There is work to be done in and around the pond this week, and Monty also begins planting out his dahlias. Adding zing to the month of May is the euphorbia, and Carol Klein visits Oxford Botanic garden to view their extensive collection.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives advice on herbs which will grow happily in shade and has an unusual choice for his summer containers, bananas. Earlier this year, Monty paid a visit to Chatsworth House to find out about the history of the extensive grounds.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team are in Aylesbury with Michelle and Alistair. They have a small back garden but they need it to work hard for them providing an entertainment and relaxation space, and somewhere to burn off steam for their two daughters, who both have autism.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team are in Norwich at the garden of Taj and Rachel, who have been together for nearly four years and have a puppy, and a baby on the way. They would love to challenge the designers to tackle the slope at the bottom of their garden.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Elaine in Lymington loves gardening, but her front garden is out of control, with loads of messy shrubs, an out-of-control conifer and a front door that the postman can't find. Can the team give purpose to the chaotic front space?

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Roxy and Steve live in Shrewsbury with their young children, but their garden has nothing exciting for children. It's so bad that when their children's nine-year-old cousin came round to play, she complained there was nothing to do in the garden.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Sheena and James have saved hard to create their dream garden. The only trouble is, despite being a gardening enthusiast, Sheena has run aground in her efforts to create a garden that is green and tree-filled but also a nod to their coastal area.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Katie and Christian and their kids Max and Olivia live in Bitterne, near Southampton. They are suffering from a classic case of 'building work ruined the garden'. In fact, mum Katie calls it a 'catastrophe' of a garden.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: The team celebrate the bounty our gardens have to offer at this time of year as Carol Klein gathers wild blackberries, Monty Don is at Longmeadow, and we join a champion vegetable grower in Yorkshire as he prepares for the biggest show of the season.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With the arrival of October, it is time to start thinking about getting some onions and garlic in the ground, and Monty Don shares his secrets on how to get a successful crop.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: In the cottage garden, Monty is moving a rose which has outgrown its space and in the vegetable garden he gives advice on what to plant now for spring. He also finds out more about the mysterious world of earthworms.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty cuts back and divides spring flowering plants, and gives advice on the pruning, dead-heading and staking of roses. Joe Swift and Adam Frost help a couple of gardeners turn a neglected area of their garden into a useable space.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins his journey in a prairie, the original American flowering wilderness. Much of the prairie has disappeared, but he meets a couple who have revived the tradition and enjoy showing it to him in full bloom.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty goes South to explore gardens of early independent America and learns how the history of this part of the country is still very much evident in the places and people he meets. He visits the famous garden of President Thomas Jefferson.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty explores the scenery of the west coast of America. He begins his journey in Arizona where he learns about cacti and marvels at the sight of them in the desert and in private gardens where they have replaced traditional plants and lawns.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don visits gardens in Florence and the Tuscan countryside, discovering that renaissance gardens were created as works of art.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in Naples visiting some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the scenery of the Amalfi Coast.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: A first look at the wonders of Egyptology; the deciphering of hieroglyphics; the techniques of ancient Egyptian embalming and mummification; the stories behind the building of the Step Pyramid of Zozer, the Pyramids at Giza and the Sphinx.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: The conflicted relationship between the Greeks and their Roman conquerors; Greek culture's impact on Rome; the founding of the Byzantine Empire, its flourishing of scholarship and theology; the role of Islamic scholars in preserving Greek learning.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: Constantinople's fall in 1453; the Greeks under the Ottomans; Europe rediscovers classical antiquity; the philosophical spirit of the Renaissance, which brings a sudden interest in the ancient Greeks; the influence of Greek mythology on Western art.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.sub-title: The Birth of the Greek Nation-State

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: Knowing what role Judaism plays in the Roman Empire; learning how Rome's experience with this stalwart monotheistic faith, the first it has encountered, differs from the challenge of the Christian faith that emerges from it.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: The first years of efforts to convert people to Christianity; the early leadership by James of those who are often called Jewish Christians; the career of Paul, from his own conversion after a vision to his work propagating the message of Jesus.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor

programme.desc: Exploring the palaces of Saddam Hussein; discovering how he calls upon the ancient Egyptians and Babylonians for inspiration; how the architecture changes over time in response to threats from Iran and the United States.

programme.desc: This lecture provides a chronological, thematic and geographical framework; understanding the visual components of the Roman Empire; especially how different forms of governments and their citizens affect their art, architecture and public display.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Learning the fundamental role of Rome's military in expanding the empire through conquest; creating and projecting the image of Roman power; introducing non-Romans to Roman values and identity.
